title: Cross-venue market comparison, Kalshi vs Polymarket (2026-08-28)
text: Cross-venue divergence on Kalshi vs Polymarket: Kalshi lists "Will Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva be on the ballot in the next Brazilian presidential election?"
